snippet.title: Still Stars Echo - Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3871940/Still_Stars_Echo/
Website: https://www.semido.me/stillstarsecho/

Coming soon to Steam and Apple platforms.

An atmospheric science-fiction journey across distant alien landscapes. Traverse monolithic structures, solve intricate puzzles, and uncover the story of a lost civilization written among the stars.
